global_events: Global risk appetite improved overnight as a revival in AI-linked buying lifted equities and pushed oil higher again, though Nvidia remains roughly a third below its record peak, so tech sentiment is still fragile. Eurozone government bond yields climbed as money rotated into riskier assets. US tariff-hike threats are pressuring trading partners to finalise deals, while Chinese factory profits are recovering unevenly, with AI-related segments capturing most of the gains.
central_banks: The US Fed's favoured inflation measure picked up to 3.8% in October, which raises the stakes for policy in 2027 and fuels commentary that the incoming Fed chief may need to tighten. Separately, Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos is reportedly set to head the European Central Bank. Indian bonds weakened going into a new government debt auction as high oil prices stoke inflation concerns, which could keep yields firm.
policy_sentiment: Delimitation Bill politics is heating up, with DMK's Stalin setting two conditions for backing it, and realtors are lobbying for affordable-housing support in Budget '28. Neither is likely to move markets immediately.

research.why: Nature: coherent time-resolved parity oscillations between states encoded by four poor man's Majoranas in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, a key step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics: two-qubit gates between strongly coupled electron qubits on solid neon, extending a promising qubit platform to entangling operations.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology: hybrid core pairing VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, linking spintronic memory to neuromorphic computing.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature Communications: canted magnetization in SrRuO3 produces a sizable out-of-plane damping-like spin torque without low crystal symmetry, useful for field-free switching of perpendicular magnetic memory.
research.title: Control of out-of-plane anti-damping spin torque with a canted ferromagnetic spin source

research.why: PRL: proposed protocol for high-purity magnon-mediated spin entanglement that avoids the usual trade-off between coupling strength and spin decay, relevant to hybrid magnon-quantum systems.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: PRL: identifies a Rashba-like interfacial spin-lattice coupling that gives kineoelasticity and nonreciprocal phonons, a new magnon-phonon route for magnonics.
research.title: Kineoelasticity and Nonreciprocal Phonons by Rashba-Induced Interfacial Spin-Lattice Coupling

research.why: Nature: the AI platform ORIDTP designs dual-target therapeutic peptides de novo with strong in vivo efficacy, a high-profile demonstration of generative AI in drug design.
research.title: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP

research.why: arXiv: a single NV center gives mode-resolved spin-wave (FMR) spectroscopy via the magnon Kerr effect, a nanoscale probe of magnetization dynamics.
research.title: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center
